profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. describes itself as a provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for the 5G/Edge, data center, cloud, enterprise, big data, HPC and embedded markets worldwide. Its site highlights GPU servers for modern data centers, AI systems built around multi-GPU and interconnect technologies, and short-depth, small form factor systems intended to bring compute, AI and connectivity performance to the edge of the network.

The company is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and trades under the ticker SMCI. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001375365.

Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 cases.
